system.name: LoCoT2V-Bench
system.one_liner: Benchmark for long-form text-to-video generation with long, complex multi-scene prompts, hierarchical metadata and a five-dimension evaluation framework (LoCoT2V-Eval).

content.variant_note: a banner with mascot and wordmark over four colour-framed panels (prompt statistics, a metadata record, method scores, evaluation tools) that meet around a central sunburst of 18 video themes
content.argues: LoCoT2V-Bench has longer, more complex prompts than other T2V benchmarks, rich structured metadata, a scoring framework built from several tools, and exposes differences among 17 long-video methods.
content.subject: Banner and wordmark, a sunburst of video themes, a prompt-statistics bar chart, a real metadata record, a top-5 score chart and the tool pipeline of LoCoT2V-Eval.

lessons.what_to_learn: Turn a benchmark overview into a dashboard: a banner with mascot and wordmark, four colour-framed panels (statistics, a real metadata record, results, evaluation tooling) around a central sunburst of categories, with each panel's colour repeated on its title strip and caption text.
lessons.suits: Benchmark and dataset papers that want to show scale, annotation richness, results and evaluation tooling on one page.

evidence: Overview of LoCoT2V-Bench. It’s a benchmark for longer text-to-video generation with complex input.
the final dataset consists of 234 videos, evenly distributed across 18 themes.
We construct structural and hierarchical metadata for our evaluation

summary: LoCoT2V-Bench is a benchmark for long text-to-video generation with long, complex, multi-scene prompts and hierarchical metadata, built from 234 real videos in 18 themes, with an evaluation framework (LoCoT2V-Eval) of five dimensions. Figure 1 is a dashboard under a banner with a train mascot and a large wordmark. Four colour-framed panels surround a two-ring sunburst of the 18 themes (Virtual 63, Daily Life 99, Nature 72): a bar chart comparing prompt length and complexity with six other benchmarks, a real record of source, prompt and scene metadata, a bar chart of the top-5 methods over five dimensions, and the tool pipeline (MLLM, SAM, VQA, RAFT, CLIP) that yields final scores.
summary_zh: LoCoT2V-Bench 是长视频生成基准，含更长更复杂的多场景提示和分层元数据，由 234 个真实视频、18 个主题构成。图 1 为仪表盘：顶部火车吉祥物与大标题，四个彩色面板环绕旭日图，展示提示统计、元数据、前五方法得分和评测工具。
notes: The caption says 13 LVG methods but the figure text and the abstract say 17. The prior pass's kinds are kept; stage-pipeline is added because the tools panel is a small pipeline. Text inside the sunburst is part of a bitmap. The train mascot is read as a pun on 'Loco' (inference). The roles of the pale-yellow cards (#f7f7d1) are inferred by hue.
